import re

CONFL = re.compile(r"^State (?P<state>\d+) conflicts: (?P<conflicts>\S.*)$")
STATE = re.compile(r"^State (?P<state>\d+)$")
RULE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<rule>\d+)\s+(?:(?P<lhs>\S+):|\|)\s+(?P<rhs>\S.*?)\s*$")
ITEM = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<rule>\d+) (?P<lhs>\S+): (?P<item>\S.*?)(?:\s{2}\[(?P<lookahead>.*)\])?$")
SYMBOL = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<symbol>\S+) \((?P<number>\d+)\)(?: (?P<rules>\d+(?: \d+)*))?$")
SIDE = re.compile(r"^\s+on (?P<side>left|right): (?P<rules>\d+(?: \d+)*)$")
ACTION = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<symbol>\S+)\s{2,}(?P<open>\[)?(?P<action>[A-Za-z].*?)\]?$")
SHIFT = re.compile(r"^shift, and go to state (?P<to_state>\d+)$")
REDUCE = re.compile(r"^reduce using rule (?P<rule>\d+) \((?P<rule_lhs>[^)]*)\)$")
GOTO = re.compile(r"^go to state (?P<to_state>\d+)$")
TITLES = {"Grammar": "grammar", "Terminals, with rules where they appear": "terminals",
          "Nonterminals, with rules where they appear": "nonterminals"}


def parse(lines):
    out = {k: [] for k in ("conflicts", "grammar", "terminals", "nonterminals", "items", "actions")}
    used = {k: [] for k in out}
    section, state, lhs, sym = None, None, None, None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if ln in TITLES:
            section = TITLES[ln]
            used[section].append(j)
            continue
        m = CONFL.match(ln)
        if m:
            out["conflicts"].append(m.groupdict())
            used["conflicts"].append(j)
            continue
        m = STATE.match(ln)
        if m:
            section, state = "state", m.group("state")
            used["items"].append(j)
            continue
        if section == "grammar":
            m = RULE.match(ln)
            if m:
                lhs = m.group("lhs") or lhs
                out["grammar"].append({"rule": m.group("rule"), "lhs": lhs, "rhs": m.group("rhs")})
                used["grammar"].append(j)
        elif section == "terminals":
            m = SYMBOL.match(ln)
            if m:
                out["terminals"].append({"symbol": m.group("symbol"), "number": m.group("number"),
                                         "rules": ",".join((m.group("rules") or "").split())})
                used["terminals"].append(j)
        elif section == "nonterminals":
            m = SYMBOL.match(ln)
            if m:
                sym = {"symbol": m.group("symbol"), "number": m.group("number"), "on left": "", "on right": ""}
                out["nonterminals"].append(sym)
                used["nonterminals"].append(j)
                continue
            m = SIDE.match(ln)
            if m and sym:
                sym["on " + m.group("side")] = ",".join(m.group("rules").split())
                used["nonterminals"].append(j)
        elif section == "state":
            m = ITEM.match(ln)
            if m:
                out["items"].append({"state": state, "rule": m.group("rule"), "lhs": m.group("lhs"),
                                     "item": m.group("item"), "lookahead": m.group("lookahead") or ""})
                used["items"].append(j)
                continue
            m = ACTION.match(ln)
            if m:
                rec = {"state": state, "symbol": m.group("symbol"), "action": m.group("action"),
                       "to_state": "", "rule": "", "rule_lhs": "", "chosen": "no" if m.group("open") else "yes"}
                text = m.group("action")
                for verb, rx in (("shift", SHIFT), ("reduce", REDUCE), ("go to", GOTO)):
                    mm = rx.match(text)
                    if mm:
                        rec["action"] = verb
                        rec.update(mm.groupdict())
                out["actions"].append(rec)
                used["actions"].append(j)
    return [{"name": k, "kind": "table", "lines": used[k], "records": out[k]} for k in out]
